message.content: Static typing catches type mismatches at compile time rather than runtime, which prevents subtle bugs from accumulating and surfacing unpredictably as a project scales. Additionally, it powers robust IDE tooling and acts as built-in documentation, allowing large teams to safely refactor, navigate, and maintain thousands of files over years with confidence.
